content.headline: The Global Gathering for Community Builders & Creators
content.sub: Join 5,000+ community strategist, developers, and ecosystem leaders defining the future of collective intelligence and digital belonging.

content.title: Architecting the Next Era of Human Connection
content.body: ComConclave is the premier summit designed specifically for community managers, platform founders, and developer advocates. Over three high-impact days, we dive deep into decentralized moderation, AI-assisted engagement, and sustainable monetization models that put members first. Whether you run a global open-source ecosystem or an exclusive private network, you will find your peers and your playbook here.

items.title: Keynote: The Sovereign Community
items.desc: How user-owned data and decentralized identity are reshaping member trust and platform governance.

items.title: Panel: AI-Augmented Moderation
items.desc: Leading scaling strategies to support moderators using custom LLMs without losing the human touch.

items.title: Workshop: Monetization Without Alienation
items.desc: Practical structures for introducing value-adds, token gates, and premium tiers that communities actually love.

items.title: Closing Panel: The Metrics That Actually Matter
items.desc: Moving past vanity engagement numbers to measure true sentiment, retention, and ecosystem health.
